timeline.body: Hi @DaveCTurner, I've created a changelog YAML for you.
Why this have to be RunOnce?

reply.body: There's no value in queueing up a no-op listener per shard update on the reroute service, there could be thousands of them.
Is it going to be called once first shard is completed or when all shards is restored from the snapshot?
Neither, this is happening when shard snapshots complete.
